agents.name: AI Agent Neo
agents.description: AI assistant for automated business tasks
agents.pricingRaw: Creati does not provide clear pricing details.
agents.shortDescription: AI assistant focused on automating routine work, analyzing information, generating reports, and helping users streamline recurring business and productivity workflows.
agents.longDescription: AI Agent Neo is a productivity-oriented AI assistant designed to reduce repetitive work and improve everyday business workflows. It can assist with routine task automation, information analysis, report generation, and project-related activities. The product is aimed at users who want to delegate recurring administrative or analytical tasks to an AI assistant. Creati highlights task automation, data insights, workflow management, report generation, and administrative automation among Neo's capabilities.

agents.name: OpenAgents
agents.pricingRaw: Creati does not provide public pricing information on the listing.
agents.shortDescription: AI productivity assistant designed to automate communication, scheduling, email organization, reminders, and other routine professional tasks.
agents.longDescription: OpenAgents is positioned as a productivity-focused AI assistant for handling routine professional work. It can help organize communication, schedule meetings, manage tasks, create reminders, and support project-related workflows through natural-language interaction. The goal is to reduce repetitive administrative work and give users a single assistant for everyday productivity tasks. Creati describes it as a productivity tool for professionals, with use cases around email organization, meeting management, task scheduling, and project planning.

agents.name: Awesome Agents
agents.pricingRaw: Creati does not provide a clear pricing model on the listing.
agents.shortDescription: AI agent directory that helps users discover, filter, categorize, and compare agent products across business, research, development, and productivity use cases.
agents.longDescription: Awesome Agents is a discovery platform rather than an execution agent itself. It organizes AI agents into categories and provides profiles and links that help users explore products for different workflows and industries. This makes it useful for researching the growing AI-agent ecosystem, comparing available tools, and finding agents that match a particular task. Creati says the directory provides curated profiles, filters, categories, usage examples, and direct links to help users compare and discover agents.
cons: It is a directory rather than an execution agent
Agent quality varies by listed product

agents.name: Agenta
agents.pricingRaw: Hobby free plan; Pro starts at $49/month on Creati.
agents.shortDescription: Open-source platform for developing and evaluating LLM applications and agents with prompt management, versioning, deployment, evaluations, and observability.
agents.longDescription: Agenta is an open-source platform built for teams developing LLM-powered applications and AI agents. It provides tools for managing and versioning prompts, evaluating application behavior, deploying workflows, and monitoring production performance. The platform brings development, evaluation, and observability into one workflow so teams can iterate on agent applications more systematically. Creati describes business professionals, project managers, data analysts, and content creators as target users for its workflow automation and reporting capabilities.

agents.name: Modus
agents.description: Modular framework for building AI agents
agents.pricingRaw: Creati does not provide a clear paid pricing model on the listing.
agents.shortDescription: Open-source framework for creating modular AI agents with LLM integrations, reusable tools, persistent memory, and workflow automation capabilities.
agents.longDescription: Modus by Hypermode is a modular framework designed for developers building customizable AI agents and intelligent workflows. It combines LLM integrations with reusable tools, persistent memory, and workflow orchestration so developers can compose more capable agent systems. Its modular architecture is intended to make individual components easier to customize and reuse across different applications. Creati notes that agents built with Modus can use plugin-based tools for data retrieval, analysis, and action execution while maintaining conversational context.
cons: Go or AssemblyScript knowledge may be needed

agents.name: OpenAgent
agents.shortDescription: Open-source framework for building autonomous AI agents with task planning, tool execution, memory management, multiple LLM backends, and extensible plugins.
agents.longDescription: OpenAgent is an open-source framework for developers who want to build autonomous AI agents capable of planning and executing multi-step tasks. It supports multiple LLM backends, external tool execution, memory management, plugins, streaming responses, and logging. These capabilities make it suitable for experimenting with research, productivity, DevOps, customer-support, and data-oriented agent workflows. Creati specifically identifies AI researchers, software developers, data scientists, automation engineers, and AI startups as users of the framework.

agents.name: Agentic Framework
agents.shortDescription: Open-source Node.js framework for building autonomous agents with persistent MongoDB memory, configurable tools, prompt templates, and workflow orchestration.
agents.longDescription: Agentic Framework provides developers with building blocks for creating autonomous AI agents and LLM-powered workflows in Node.js. It includes persistent memory backed by MongoDB, customizable tools, prompt templates, and orchestration components for multi-step workflows. The framework is particularly useful for applications where agents need to retain context and interact with external data or services. Creati says the framework can be used for knowledge retrieval, automated customer support, data analysis, and process automation.

agents.name: Live by Vroom AI
agents.description: Browser extension for AI task automation
agents.pricingRaw: Creati does not provide a clear pricing model on the listing.
agents.shortDescription: Browser-based AI agent extension that understands webpages and helps users summarize content, extract data, fill forms, answer questions, and automate workflows.
agents.longDescription: Live by Vroom AI brings AI agents directly into the browser so they can work with the content and context of webpages. It can assist with research, summarization, structured data extraction, form filling, question answering, and other repetitive browser tasks. Its extension-based approach allows users to apply AI assistance directly within existing web workflows instead of moving information into a separate application. Creati also describes a plugin architecture that lets users add capabilities such as summarization, data extraction, form filling, and custom workflows.

agents.name: CoTester by TestGrid
agents.pricingRaw: Freemium plan; paid plans listed from $25/month on Creati.
agents.shortDescription: AI testing agent that generates executable tests from requirements, understands application interfaces, and automatically maintains tests when UI changes occur.
agents.longDescription: CoTester by TestGrid is an AI-powered software testing agent designed to automate large parts of the QA lifecycle. It can turn requirements and user stories into executable test cases, understand application interfaces using vision-language capabilities, and automatically heal tests when interfaces change. It also supports execution across real browsers and devices, making it useful for regression, functional, and cross-platform testing. Creati specifically highlights support for no-code, low-code, and pro-code authoring, along with scheduled runs and CI/CD integration hooks.
cons: Edge cases may need manual scripting

agents.name: MiniMax Agent
agents.pricingRaw: Creati lists no paid starting price; current pricing is available on the product pricing page.
agents.shortDescription: No-code platform for building custom AI assistants from documents, proprietary knowledge, and structured conversation flows. It supports knowledge-grounded responses and deployment across supported web and workplace channels.
agents.longDescription: MiniMax Agent helps teams create custom AI assistants without building an agent system from scratch. Users can provide documents and knowledge sources, configure retrieval and conversation behavior, and deploy assistants for support, internal knowledge, sales, and onboarding workflows. The platform is designed to make agent creation accessible to non-technical teams while still supporting structured business use cases. Creati also lists customer support, internal knowledge assistance, sales lead qualification, and HR onboarding as example applications.
cons: Pricing is not clearly shown on Creati
